question: Does VARE’s explicit per-rollout-group advantage override change an actual pinned RVL GRPO model update relative to the trainer’s default prompt-ID merge when two VARE groups share one prompt ID?
hypothesis: For the same eight completions and rewards, the two-group VARE arm produces the per-group advantage vector and a different real model update from RVL’s default prompt-ID merge, while a one-group VARE control matches the native advantages and update exactly.

estimand.primary: Paired model-parameter fingerprints and maximum absolute parameter difference for three one-step arms from the same exact incumbent: native prompt-ID default, VARE one-group control, and VARE two-group treatment.
estimand.group_advantages: Population-standardized, clipped rewards computed separately within each declared VARE group in original sample order.
estimand.native_advantages: Pinned RVL prompt-ID grouped population-standardized, clipped rewards for the same rewards and sample order.
estimand.scope: Trainer integration correctness only; synthetic labels; not policy quality or task success.

model.role: cached model used only to exercise CPU GRPO execution; its prior task cohorts remain retired

sampling.user: Output exactly one uppercase letter from A, B, C, or D. Do not add any other text.
sampling.rendered_prompt:
<|im_start|>system
Follow the user instruction exactly.<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
Output exactly one uppercase letter from A, B, C, or D. Do not add any other text.<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
sampling.selection: No completion selection or resampling. The positive-reward response token sequence must differ from every zero-reward response in the first group; otherwise retain the run as gate failure and do not rerun this protocol.

arms: pinned RVL train_step with default prompt-ID advantages
VARE adapter with all eight samples declared as one group (same-group positive control)
VARE adapter with two groups of four sharing one prompt ID (treatment)
update.initial_state: Restore the same exact model weights, optimizer state, CPU RNG, and training mode before each arm; verify incumbent restoration after each arm.

secondary_metrics: exact advantage vectors for both arms
changed parameter tensor counts and maximum deltas from incumbent
finite and nonzero gradient tensor counts
exact incumbent state restoration after each arm
success_criteria: All pinned source and model hashes match.
The positive-reward response token sequence differs from every zero-reward response in the first group; otherwise fail this evidence gate without rerunning.
The native trainer’s intercepted advantage vector equals independent prompt-ID normalization within 1e-10.
The one-group VARE control advantages equal the native vector and its post-step parameter fingerprint exactly matches the native arm.
The two-group VARE treatment advantages equal independent per-group normalization within 1e-10.
Each of the three arms invokes exactly one train_step and exactly one actual optimizer.step, with finite nonzero gradients and at least one changed parameter tensor.
The two-group treatment parameter fingerprint differs from native and its maximum absolute parameter difference is greater than zero.
Each arm restores incumbent weights, optimizer state, CPU RNG, and model training mode exactly.
Incomplete groups and mixed grouped/ungrouped batches are rejected before train_step or optimizer mutation, preserving the incumbent state.
The run stays below 1200 seconds and 22 GiB peak RSS on CPU.
failure_criteria: Any source/model hash mismatch, missing response-diversity gate, incorrect advantage vector, failed same-group positive control, incomplete/mixed group reaching train_step, missing/nonfinite gradient, zero actual optimizer steps or more than one, failed restoration, indistinguishable treatment update, or resource cap violation.
explicit_nonclaims: No task-success or held-out capability evaluation.
Rewards are a frozen synthetic witness, not verifier labels or true correctness.
A changed update establishes trainer-boundary integration only; it does not show that either direction is better.
Same-host author execution is not external reproduction.
validation_authority: The runner enforces and records its frozen gates; a separate auditor independently replays advantage vectors, source/artifact hashes, update-fingerprint relationships, malformed-group rejection outcomes, and resource limits. The study decision is PASS only if the runner status is completed and the auditor decision is pass.
